html_bullets.point: Jubilant Ingrevia Limited declared that its promoters and associated parties have not made any encumbrance on the company's shares during the financial year ending March 31, 2025, in compliance with SEBI regulations.
Standalone net sales for March 2025 decreased by 6.25% year-on-year to Rs 971.98 crore, while net profit increased significantly by 190.09% to Rs 89.87 crore compared to Rs 30.98 crore in March 2024.
EBITDA rose by 57.8% to Rs 163.48 crore, and EPS improved to Rs 5.64 from Rs 1.94 year-on-year.
Consolidated net profit for the March 2025 quarter increased by 153.16% to Rs 74.05 crore, despite a 2.08% decline in sales to Rs 1038.16 crore.
For the full year, net profit rose by 37.33% to Rs 251.17 crore, with sales increasing marginally by 0.57% to Rs 4123.67 crore.
Total revenue for FY25 increased by 1% to ₹4,178 Crore, while profit after tax rose by 37% to ₹251 Crore.
The Board declared a final dividend of 250%, totaling ₹79.8 Crore for the fiscal year.

heading: Board Meeting Outcomes and Auditor Appointments

html_bullets.point: The Board approved the re-appointment of M/s J.K. Kabra & Co. as Cost Auditors for FY 2025-26 and M/s DMK Associates as Secretarial Auditors for a five-year term.
M/s Walker Chandiok & Co. LLP was re-appointed as Statutory Auditors for another five years, subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming AGM.

heading: Dividend Announcement and Financial Results Approval

html_bullets.point: The Board approved the audited financial results for the year ended March 31, 2025 and recommended a final dividend of 250% (Rs. 2.50 per share).
The record date for the dividend is set for July 25, 2025.

Jubilant Ingrevia Limited uploaded the audio recording of its investors' conference call regarding the audited financial results for the year ended March 31, 2025. The recording is accessible via the company's website.
